profile.headline: Full Stack Engineer
profile.summary: As a creative problem solver, my colleagues and employers appreciate my flexibility and heroic attention to detail. At my best in challenging environments, I thrive while meeting tight deadlines and high expectations.

positions.title: Tutor - Full Stack Web Development
positions.description: Provide remote tutoring to students studying web development at various universities in the U.S. covering topics like JavaScript frameworks, SQL, database design, RESTful API design, asynchronous logic, test driven development, UI/UX, and deployment.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer (via InConsulting Inc.)
positions.description:
Five month apprenticeship during which I designed and implemented telemetry capture for Pipelines tasks owned by the Azure DevOps Artifacts Core team.
Migrated existing assemblies in internal tools from .Net Framework to .Net Standard.

positions.title: IT Contractor - PJ537 (via Insight Global)
positions.description:
Contracted to support the world's largest aerospace company.
Installing, scripting, and troubleshooting of aircraft software and ARINC services. 
Recommending software changes / configurations.
Creating, backing up, and restoring images.
Troubleshooting complex network issues, including packet analysis, DHCP, subnetting and Port configuration.

positions.title: IT Contractor - OS0005 (via Insight Global)
positions.description:
Contracted to support the world's largest aerospace company.
Coordinate with networking and infrastructure teams to ensure near 100% up-time of
fiber network connections.
Configure and deploy wireless access points, workstations, and other devices both in aircraft and in a factory environment.
Troubleshoot and resolve moderate to severe hardware and software issues.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Technician
positions.description:
Develop extensive test suites covering all aspects of products in development and production.
Perform all phases of testing from both black-box and grey-box perspectives.
Assemble and maintain a current QA lab to facilitate testing in multiple environments.
Evaluate new applications and technologies for potential in-house use.
Provide technical support for both coworkers and clients.

positions.title: Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
Maintained ASP.NET MVC web apps using C# in Visual Studio
Developed HTML5 and CSS3 compliant responsive web sites managed by Umbraco CMS, nopCommerce, and cPanel.
Provided remote and onsite IT support for small businesses.

positions.title: Leasing Agent
positions.description:
Assist prospective residents in completing lease agreements in accordance with State and local rental laws.
Thoroughly educate residents on required stipulations in lease agreements.
Conduct market surveys to tailor competitive offerings.
Develop and implement community events to increase resident retention.
Engage with current and prospective residents to ensure that they feel heard and that their concerns are properly addressed.

honors.title: Grow with Google Developer Scholarship
honors.description:
Web Developer - Mobile Web Specialist Nanodegree

"Out of tens of thousands of students in the Grow with Google Challenge Scholarship, your progress in the course and dedication in the community really stood out. We've been impressed and we're excited for you to continue the journey and grow even stronger as a developer!"
